topic: The day a week you lose to paperwork
hook: You are not bad at paperwork. You are doing it twice.
objective: Show a contractor that the admin time they treat as unavoidable is a system problem, not a discipline problem.
cta: See what one day of jobs looks like in Altair.

beats.narration: Every contractor I talk to says the same thing. The work is fine. It is everything after the work that eats the week.
beats.visualDirection: Fast cuts: hand flipping a worn spiral notebook, a messy whiteboard schedule with crossed-out names, a shoebox overflowing with receipts
beats.caption: The work is fine. It is everything after.
